entries.title: Navigation and settings polish
changes: Added a compact Gemini API key help guide with setup steps and common error troubleshooting.
Added Favorite Artists beside Playlists on wide Home layouts and retained a compact stacked layout on phones.
Added horizontal swipes between Home, Library, Search and Settings without hijacking vertical scrolls, tracks, rails, controls or settings subpages.
Simplified the footer to “Made with ♥ by Machhar”.
Hid the waveform canvas and effect-only styling when Audio Waveform is Off; regular playback progress remains visible without glow.

entries.title: Local Gemini keys and performance profile
changes: Added Settings key manager for up to four local Gemini API keys with hide/show, save, test and fallback rotation.
Removed the same-origin Gemini API proxy; AI song identification now calls Google Gemini directly from the browser.
Added automatic Low-End Performance Profile and reduced artwork warm-up bursts, duplicate Web Audio setup and waveform canvas work.

entries.title: Production polish and performance mode
changes: Added Low-End Device Mode to reduce costly blur, shadows and nonessential motion, with a lower waveform frame rate.
Moved Lyrics Style into the dedicated Lyrics Display section and retained saved lyrics display preferences.
Added a built-in changelog fallback so release notes remain visible offline or when the changelog file cannot be fetched.
Replaced developer-facing setup messages with user-focused copy and updated the service-worker cache version.

entries.title: Waveform and lyrics layout refinement
changes: Capped the seek-bar canvas to a compact height and reduced waveform amplitude, frequency and secondary oscillation.
The active waveform replaces the played-section baseline; the unplayed timeline remains visible as a separate thin line.
Waveform stays static while paused and clears when the player or effect is closed.
Added saved lyrics position, fine offset, text size, line spacing, width and active-line emphasis controls.
Reworked mobile lyrics mode to reserve space for playback controls and keep text scrollable and centered without clipping.
Added a Change & Update Log page that fetches release notes from changlog.json.
Versioned the service-worker cache so the updated interface and release notes can replace older cached assets.

entries.title: Theme and settings refinements
changes: Added grouped settings, personal appearance preferences and solid surface styling.
Added a server-side experimental Gemini song identification endpoint while keeping the key out of client JavaScript.
